THEACTIVEROBBERY.TASK: Make entry at the mansion. Be aware of possible intruders!

ANIMAL.TEXT: Dispatch, false alarm here, an animal has caused this.
10-4, find the animal and see if ~r~animal control is necessary.

ACTION.SURRENDER: Fuck, the cops, you caught me...
ACTION.FLEEONFOOT: Oh shit! How did the pigs came that quickly?!
ACTION.FISTFIGHT: Hey you asshole! I'll fuck you up!
Get the fuck away from me!
ACTION.KNIFEFIGHT: Oh, you shouldn't have got here...
Have you ever been stabbed?! Hahaha!
ACTION.GUNFIGHT: Oh, you shouldn't have got here...
Did you ever got shot?! Now you will be!

SMOKE_DETECTOR_FIRE.TEXT: You can toggle the alarm by pressing {SKIPKEY}
There is no burglary here, we have a ~r~fire~s~ instead!
Get a ~o~fire extinguisher~s~ or call the ~r~fire department!

THEINVESTIGATE.TASK: The cavalry is already on scene. Talk to the leading officer for more info.

SEARCHFOREVIDENCE.TEXT: You found all evidence! ~o~Go talk to the CSI outside!

SUSPECTACTION.TEXT: The suspect is fleeing on foot! Intercept and apprehend!
The suspect is attacking with a melee weapon! Subdue them!

D_COP_1.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ Glad you're here. Scene is secure, but whoever did this is long gone.
~y~You:~s~ Any idea what we're dealing with?
~b~Officer:~s~ This wasn't random. They knew exactly where to go and what to avoid.
~b~Officer:~s~ CSI is already inside. He needs help logging everything.
~b~Officer:~s~ Walk the rooms, find the evidence. We need solid leads before this trail goes cold.
~b~Officer:~s~ And watch your step — don't contaminate anything CSI is working on.

D_COP_2.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ Hey. Suspect is gone, scene is clear. Forensics has someone inside already.
~y~You:~s~ What do we know so far?
~b~Officer:~s~ Honestly? Whoever did this had no idea what they were doing.
~b~Officer:~s~ Knocked things over, left a trail through half the rooms. Just... sloppy.
~y~You:~s~ So how did they get away?
~b~Officer:~s~ Wrong place, wrong time for us. Right place for them.
~b~Officer:~s~ Go inside and log the evidence. Shouldn't be hard to find — they left plenty behind.

D_COP_3.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ Well, the bird has flown. No suspect, just a messy crime scene.
~y~You:~s~ Do we have anyone on the inside?
~b~Officer:~s~ Just a CSI tech. He won't bother you, doing his own thing.
~y~You:~s~ What do you need from me?
~b~Officer:~s~ Hunt for clues. We don't really know what we're dealing with yet.
~b~Officer:~s~ Could be anything. Just find the evidence and let forensics figure it out.
~b~Officer:~s~ Take your time. Let's do this by the book.

D_COP2_1.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ Whoever pulled this off knew what they were doing.
~b~Officer:~s~ No noise, no broken glass, no wasted time. In and out.
~b~Officer:~s~ Not since I got here. But I guarantee you — they came through here on the way out.
~b~Officer:~s~ Clean exit. No panic. This person has done this before.

D_COP2_2.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ I'm securing the side entrance. Exciting stuff.
~b~Officer:~s~ You see those security guys out front? Fifty bucks an hour.
~b~Officer:~s~ And the burglar still walked right in like he owned the place.
~b~Officer:~s~ Pure luck, if you ask me. Guy probably tripped over himself the whole way through.
~b~Officer:~s~ Ask the rent-a-cops. Oh wait — they don't know either.

D_COP2_3.TEXT: ~b~Officer:~s~ Hey. Nobody gets through this door. Those are my orders.
~b~Officer:~s~ Owner called it in himself. From his yacht. His second yacht.
~b~Officer:~s~ Security thinks it was a pro. CSI inside thinks it was a lucky amateur.
~b~Officer:~s~ I think it's above my pay grade. Door duty, remember?

D_CSI_1A.TEXT: ~y~You:~s~ Found this near the side entrance. Looks relevant.
~o~CSI:~s~ Good eye. This is exactly the kind of thing I was hoping for.
~o~CSI:~s~ My colleague grabbed a few samples inside as well. Combined, this could give us a solid profile.
~o~CSI:~s~ I'll be in the van. Someone this careful doesn't make many mistakes — let's find them.
~o~CSI:~s~ Precision takes time. I'll be thorough.

D_CSI_1B.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Alright. We got a partial print and some fiber traces. Not much, but enough.
~o~CSI:~s~ Whoever this was, they were careful. But not careful enough.
~o~CSI:~s~ I sent everything to dispatch. They'll have a suspect description shortly.
~o~CSI:~s~ This person has done this before. The record will show it — I'm sure of it.

D_CSI_2A.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Hm. Security walked all over this place and you still found something — impressive.
~o~CSI:~s~ My colleague grabbed a few samples too. Amateur work leaves a lot behind, so we should have plenty.
~o~CSI:~s~ I'll be in the van. Shouldn't take long with this much to work with.

D_CSI_2B.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Well. More than I expected, honestly — but that tracks.
~o~CSI:~s~ Prints, fibers, tool marks. This person left a trail a rookie could follow.
~o~CSI:~s~ Sent everything to dispatch already. They'll have a description for you soon.
~o~CSI:~s~ Fast? With this much evidence it basically analyzed itself.

D_CSI_3A.TEXT: ~y~You:~s~ I found some evidence. Take a look at this.
~o~CSI:~s~ Interesting... parts of this look deliberate. Other parts look rushed.
~o~CSI:~s~ My colleague found some traces inside too. Maybe together it'll start making sense.
~o~CSI:~s~ I'll run everything in the van. Give me a few minutes.
~o~CSI:~s~ Don't go too far. I might have questions.

D_CSI_3B.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Okay, so... it's a mixed picture.
~o~CSI:~s~ Some of this looks like someone who knew exactly what they were doing.
~o~CSI:~s~ Other parts? Pure chaos. I honestly can't give you a clean profile.
~y~You:~s~ So what do we tell dispatch?
~o~CSI:~s~ I sent them everything. Let them figure it out — that's above my pay grade.
~o~CSI:~s~ Good luck. You're going to need a little of it on this one.

D_CSI2_1.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Careful with that door frame — I just finished dusting it.
~o~CSI:~s~ Barely a trace. Gloves, almost certainly. Deliberate movement through the room.
~o~CSI:~s~ This person knew where the cameras were. They didn't stumble around.
~o~CSI:~s~ Do that. And log everything — even the smallest detail matters with someone this careful.

D_CSI2_2.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Look at these tool marks on the lock. Textbook amateur.
~o~CSI:~s~ Not even close. Panicked, rushed, left traces in every room.
~o~CSI:~s~ Honestly I'm surprised they found what they were looking for at all.
~o~CSI:~s~ Good. They dropped things on the way out — you'll find something for sure.

D_CSI2_3.TEXT: ~o~CSI:~s~ Hey. Just another Tuesday in Los Santos.
~o~CSI:~s~ That's the weird part — some things look rushed and sloppy, other things look deliberate.
~o~CSI:~s~ I can't figure this one out yet. Could go either way.
~y~You:~s~ I'll do a walkthrough and tag what I find.
~o~CSI:~s~ Good. Maybe what you find will help me make up my mind.

D_SECURITY_1.TEXT: ~r~Security:~s~ That's right. Alarm came in at 2:47. I was here in under four minutes.
~r~Security:~s~ But they were already gone. Not a trace of them left outside.
~r~Security:~s~ Whoever it was knew this property. Avoided every blind spot, every camera angle.
~r~Security:~s~ I've been doing this for eleven years. This wasn't an amateur.
~r~Security:~s~ The east side door was unlocked from the inside when I arrived. Nobody could explain that.

D_SECURITY_2.TEXT: ~y~You:~s~ Walk me through what happened tonight.
~r~Security:~s~ Alarm triggered, we responded, we secured the perimeter. System worked fine.
~y~You:~s~ But the burglar was already gone.
~r~Security:~s~ The owner chose the basic package. One guard, four cameras. That's what he paid for.
~r~Security:~s~ Look — this guy got lucky. Pure and simple.
~y~You:~s~ Did you see anything before the alarm went off?
~r~Security:~s~ Nothing out of the ordinary. He must have slipped in during my rounds.
~r~Security:~s~ ...There was a van down the street. Grey. But that's probably nothing.
~r~Security:~s~ Don't look at me like that, officer.

D_SECURITY_3.TEXT: ~y~You:~s~ Hey — you were first on scene?
~r~Security:~s~ Yes sir. Alarm came in at 2:47, I was here by 2:51.
~r~Security:~s~ Side door was already open when I arrived. Not forced — just open.
~r~Security:~s~ Honestly? I don't know. Something about this doesn't add up.
~r~Security:~s~ Felt professional from the outside. But inside looks like a mess.
~r~Security:~s~ I've seen both. This one... I can't tell you which it is.

FIRSTOFFICERTALK.TEXT: ~g~Hint:~s~ We have received tips where the evidence is located.
